meanings.usage: 表示通过邮寄、传递等方式收到某物
用于描述过去担任某职务或处于某种状态的人或事物
指中小学校的男性校长
指停止工作并离开工作岗位
尤指中小学生，通常指年龄较小的学生
常与towards连用，表示为某事出钱或出力
指向他人赠送的东西，也可指天赋
指能够耐心等待或忍受困难的能力
作名词指理解力，作形容词指善于理解他人的
指向他人提供精神上的支持和激励
用于正式场合的告别，或指送别宴会
常与to连用，将时间、精力等用于某事
用于强调程度，意思是完全、彻底
指对新事物有浓厚兴趣或指事物不寻常

examples.en: I informed him that the meeting had been postponed.
examples.zh: 我通知他会议已经推迟了。

examples.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names.
examples.zh: 所有为这份礼物捐款的人都将签名。

examples.en: We sent him a present to mark the occasion.
examples.zh: 我们送他一份礼物以纪念这个时刻。

examples.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience.
examples.zh: 我们将永远因他的耐心而记住佩奇先生。

examples.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour.
examples.zh: 许多老校友将出席为他举行的告别晚宴。

examples.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.

examples.zh: 当我们不情愿地去上学时，他给了我们鼓励。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在，并且可能继续下去的动作。常与表示一段时间的时间状语连用，如for+时间段、since+时间点。 用于询问或描述一个持续进行且可能仍在继续的动作，强调动作的持续性。疑问句将have/has提前。

examples.en: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
examples.zh: 佩奇先生教了多久的书了？

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for two hours.
examples.zh: 我已经等了你两个小时了。

examples.en: She has been working here since 2010.
examples.zh: 她从2010年起就在这里工作了。

grammar.title: 将来完成进行时 (Future Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + will + have + been + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示在将来某一时刻之前已经开始并一直持续到该时刻的动作。构成形式为：will + have + been + 动词-ing。 用于描述到将来某个时间点已经持续了多长时间的动作，常与by + 将来的时间点连用。

examples.en: Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years by then.
examples.zh: 到那时佩奇先生将已经教了四十年书。

examples.en: By next month, I will have been living here for five years.
examples.zh: 到下个月，我将已经在这里住了五年。

grammar.title: 现在完成时与现在完成进行时的区别
grammar.structure: 现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词；现在完成进行时：have/has + been + 现在分词
grammar.definition: 现在完成时强调动作已完成或结果；现在完成进行时强调动作的持续性，有时带有感情色彩。 表示延续性动词两者均可使用，但现在完成进行时更强调动作的持续过程。短暂动词只能用现在完成时。

examples.en: I have read the book. (已完成) / I have been reading the book. (一直在读)
examples.zh: 我已经读完了这本书。/ 我一直在读这本书。

examples.en: I have lived here for ten years. / I have been living here for ten years.

patterns.pattern: How long has + 主语 + been + 动词-ing?

How long has he been learning English?

patterns.pattern: 主语 + will have been + 动词-ing + for + 时间段

original.en: Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
original.zh: 佩奇先生将教满整整四十年书。

imitations.en: By next year, she will have been teaching for twenty years.

imitations.en: He will have been living here for five years by December.
imitations.zh: 到十二月，他将在这里住满五年。

patterns.pattern: It is a curious coincidence that + 从句

original.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for forty years.
original.zh: 说来也巧，就在他退休前一天，佩奇先生将教满四十年书。

imitations.en: It is a curious coincidence that we met again after ten years.
imitations.zh: 说来也巧，我们在十年后又相遇了。

imitations.en: It is a curious coincidence that both of them chose the same university.
imitations.zh: 真是巧合，他们两人都选择了同一所大学。

original.en: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
original.zh: 退休后他将致力于园艺。

imitations.en: She will devote herself to teaching after retirement.
imitations.zh: 退休后她将致力于教学。

imitations.en: He decided to devote himself to writing.

lines.en: teaching I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr.. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
lines.zh: 我刚刚收到母校的一封信，通知我说以前的校长斯图亚特。佩奇先生下星期就退休了。

lines.en: Pupils of the school, old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion .
lines.zh: 为了纪念这个日子，学校的学生——无论老同学还是新同学——将送他一件礼物。

lines.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
lines.zh: 所有凑钱买此礼品的人都将自己的名字签在一本大签名簿上，签名簿将被送到校长的家里。

lines.en: We shall all remember Mr.. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
lines.zh: 我们不会忘记佩奇先生对我们既有耐心又充满理解，也不会忘记在我们不愿去上学时他给予我们的亲切鼓励。

lines.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
lines.zh: 很多老同学都准备参加下星期四为他举行的告别宴会。

lines.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement , Mr.. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
lines.zh: 佩奇先生退休的前一天正好是他执教满40年的日子，这真是奇妙的巧合。

lines.en: After he has retired , he will devote himself to gardening.
lines.zh: 他退休后，将致力于园艺。

lines.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
lines.zh: 对于他来说，这将是一种全新的爱好。

lines.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
lines.zh: 但这没有关系，因为正如他常说的那样，人要活到老学到老。

questions.a: For a total of forty years.

questions.q: What does the sentence 'one is never too old to learn' suggest about Mr. Page?

questions.aZh: 即使退休，他也愿意不断学习新的事物。
questions.hint: 结合结尾“an entirely new hobby”与主题句 one is never too old to learn 理解。

translation:
我刚刚收到母校的一封信，通知我说以前的校长斯图亚特。
佩奇先生下星期就退休了。
为了纪念这个日子，学校的学生——无论老同学还是新同学——将送他一件礼物。
所有凑钱买此礼品的人都将自己的名字签在一本大签名簿上，签名簿将被送到校长的家里。
我们不会忘记佩奇先生对我们既有耐心又充满理解，也不会忘记在我们不愿去上学时他给予我们的亲切鼓励。
很多老同学都准备参加下星期四为他举行的告别宴会。
佩奇先生退休的前一天正好是他执教满40年的日子，这真是奇妙的巧合。
他退休后，将致力于园艺。
对于他来说，这将是一种全新的爱好。
但这没有关系，因为正如他常说的那样，人要活到老学到老。
title: Never too old to learn
subtitle: 活到老学到老

lead.question: 佩奇先生执教多少年后退休？同学们准备怎样纪念这位老校长？
lead.warmup: 在每个人的学生时代，总有一位令人难忘的老师。本课作者收到母校来信，得知当年那位既耐心又善解人意的老校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下周就要退休了。为了纪念这个特殊的日子，学校的新老同学纷纷凑钱要送他一件礼物，还要在下周四为他举办一场告别宴会。更巧的是，他退休的前一天恰好执教满四十年，退休后他又将投身于园艺这个全新的爱好。
goals: 掌握 inform、headmaster、pupil、retire、honourable、odd、decent、completely 等本课核心词汇。
理解并会用 in one's honour、devote oneself to、mark the occasion 等短语。
辨析现在完成时与一般过去时，会用将来进行时和将来完成进行时描述将来。
区分 old 与 elder 的用法，体会 old and new 作非限定性定语的作用。
lead.summary: 作者收到母校来信，得知前校长佩奇先生下周退休。为纪念这一刻，新老同学将送他礼物，所有出资者在签名簿上签名，签名簿随后寄往校长家。大家感念他的耐心、理解与亲切鼓励。下周四，许多former pupils将参加为他举办的 farewell dinner。巧合的是，他退休前一天正好执教满四十年。退休后他将致力于园艺——一个全新的爱好。但他并不在意，因为正如他常说的：活到老，学到老。
lead.tips: elder 只用于家庭成员，'母校'应说 my old school（不能用 elder）；in one's honour 表示'为向某人表示敬意'，注意是 one's 而非 the。

exercises.q: 我刚刚收到母校的一封信，通知我说我的前校长斯图亚特·佩奇先生下星期就要退休了。
exercises.a: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
exercises.note: inform用现在分词表伴随；retire用将来进行时。

exercises.q: They will hold a farewell dinner for him next Thursday. A great many former pupils will attend it.（用 in his honour 合并为一句）
exercises.a: A great many former pupils will attend a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
exercises.note: in one's honour 表示“为向某人表示敬意”。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空：After he ____ (retire) next week, Mr. Page will devote ____ (he) to gardening.
exercises.note: retire用现在完成时；devote oneself to接动名词。

exercises.q: 用 old 或 elder 填空：（1）My ____ brother is now a headmaster.（2）I have just received a letter from my ____ school.
exercises.note: elder只用于家人；old可指“旧的/以前的”。

exercises.q: 改错：Mr. Page has retired last week, so we held a farewell dinner for him.
exercises.a: Mr. Page retired last week, so we held a farewell dinner for him.
exercises.note: last week等明确过去时间用一般过去时。

exercises.q: 他是一位可敬又正直的校长，我们都为他感到骄傲。
exercises.a: He is an honourable and decent headmaster, and we are all proud of him.
exercises.note: be proud of后接名词或代词。

exercises.q: 用 odd 或 completely 填空：It is a(n) ____ coincidence that he had ____ completed forty years of teaching.

quiz.q: 佩奇先生退休前执教满多少年？
作者是从哪里得知前校长即将退休的消息的？
quiz.note: a letter from my old school。

quiz.q: 按照课文，那本签好名的签名簿将被送往何处？
佩奇先生退休后准备把精力投入什么？
哪一句最能解释“one is never too old to learn”？
options: You can always learn new things, however old you are.
Learning is too hard for old people.
quiz.note: 主题句含义：活到老，学到老。

quiz.q: 关于“will have been teaching”，下列说法正确的是？
options: It is the future perfect continuous.
